description: Requires OAuth and the 'submit_requests' permission. Without confirm: true it only previews which eligible listings would be queued (status preview) — show that list to the person and get a yes first. With confirm: true it queues removal requests for exactly those listings, using the approval the person already gave on the website and their paid plan. It cannot approve listings, pick new sites, or buy anything: approval_required and entitlement_required send the person to the website. A request is not a removal.

confirm.description: true only after the person has seen the preview and said yes.

name: submit_approved_plan
title: Queue the removal requests the person already approved
